Commentary.Commentary: Right then that is all we have from this one-sided affair. The action in the Women's T20 World Cup 2023 continues on Thursday16th February and we have just one game to look forward to. Sri Lanka Women will clash against Australia Women at Saint George's Park in Gqeberha and the game will begin at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT) but as you know, our build-up will begin well in advance. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

Bismah Maroof the captain of Pakistan Women says that it was a clinical performance in all the departments. Lauds Muneeba Ali for her knock. Adds that it was good of Muneeba Ali and Nida Dar to bat deep and take them to a healthy score. Mentions that they need to work on the fast bowling but the spinners were exceptional today. Closes by saying that they were disappointed after the India loss but happy with the win tonight and will look to carry the momentum ahead.

Laura Delany the skipper of Ireland Women says that they underperformed and they are disappointed with their effort as they gave too much width and found it hard to get wickets. Adds that with the bat they showed intent but overall were not good enough and fell considerably short in this game. Mentions that she has a nice group of players to captain and they are getting better with every game with Orla Prendergast is the perfect example as she performs better every time she gets out in the middle. Claims that Amy Hunter and Cara Murray are young spinners with a bright future and as long as they are improving it is good for the team. States that they want to do their best in the next game and that it is a lovely pitch to bat on.  Ends by saying that Muneeba Ali was brilliant and wishes her the best.

Muneeba Ali is undoubtedly the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for scoring 102 runs in 68 balls. She says that as soon as she got a start, she was confident to take it deep. Adds that she thought about the century at the 12-13 overs and is happy that she got it at the end. Mentions that she played to her strengths and used the field around to maneuver the balls in the gaps. Credits Nida Dar for giving her constant support in the middle on her way through to the hundred. Ends by saying that she wishes to dedicate this award to her captain and teammates who were down after the India Women's game but credits her team for putting on a strong show today.
Time for the presentations...

Pakistan Women were right on the money with the ball and it is the first time their spinners have claimed nine wickets in a World Cup game. Nashra Sandhu was once again the pick of the bowlers claiming four wickets for 18 runs in her four overs. Fatima Sana was the one who started the onslaught but it was the only wicket taken by the pace bowler with Nida Dar and Sadia Iqbal chipping in with two wickets each. Nida Dar bowled a lovely spell conceding just 5 runs in her three over with a maiden and Tuba Hassan also took one wicket in her first World Cup match. The win was however set up but an outstanding century by Muneeba Ali and she was well supported by Nida Dar. The Ireland Women bowlers were quite ineffective and left a massive task for their batters to achieve.

This has been a walk in the park for the Pakistan Women! They have beaten Ireland Women by a comprehensive margin of 70 runs. They have kept themselves well and truly alive in this competition by coming back from a disappointing loss against their arch-rivals. Ireland Women were never really in this game as they were beaten comprehensively in all facets of the game. Amy Hunter and Gaby Lewis could not get going in this match and Orla Prendergast looked like she could pull this off but was dismissed on 31. Eimear Richardson played a good cameo scoring 28 in 17 balls but there was no contribution from any other batter. Ireland Women's hunt for their maiden win in a World Cup continues and they are at the bottom of the table.

OUT! Pakistan Women have done this with ease! Sadia Iqbal bowls a beautiful delivery that drifts and turns after pitching and takes the top of off. Leah Paul had no clue about it as she played it from the crease and the ball hits timber. This has been a remarkable bowling performance by Pakistan Women as they have bowled their opponents out inside the 17th over. Ireland Women's batting woes continue and they have succumbed to yet another defeat.
Leah Paul takes it on the full and bunts it back at the bowler.
Sadia Iqbal floats this one full and outside off. Leah Paul knocks this towards mid off.
A low full toss on the stumps. Jane Maguire bunts it back to the bowler.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Pakistan Women are being ruthless now as they want to head back to their hotel room at the earliest! Quicker delivery, full and straight on the stumps. Cara Murray plays all around it and does not get her bat in time. The ball crashes into the stumps. Nida Dar takes her second and has been outstanding in this game. Pakistan Women are just one wicket away from comfortably winning this match.
Short and outside off. Leah Paul cuts it to cover-point and takes a quick single.
Shortish and turns outside off. Leah Paul goes for the cut but misses.
Fuller one outside off. Cara Murray uses her feet and works it to covers for one.
Flatter one turns into the batter. Cara Murray defends it to covers.
Short and outside off. Cara Murray cuts it to covers and a misfield allows Murray to take one.
Cara Murray makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sadia Iqbal has her first wicket and joins the party as well! Slower and full outside off. Arlene Kelly looks to the scoop and chips it off the cue end of the bat to the short fine leg region. Aiman Anwer runs forward and takes a good low catch to dismiss Arlene Kelly for 1 as Pakistan Women take their eighth wicket and are inching towards victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiman Anwer b Sadia Iqbal

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker on the leg peg. Arlene Kelly uses her feet and fails to get any bat on it. Works off her pad to the onside.
Flat on the leg peg. Leah Paul tucks it to the square leg for one.
Short and outside off. Arlene Kelly punches it down to long on for one.
Flat on the leg stump. Leah Paul works it to square leg for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in the over and Pakistan Women are close to a comprehensive win! Nashra Sandhu bowls this short and outside the off pole. Mary Waldron charges down the wicket and looks to cut this but end up slicing it into the hands of the point fielder. Javeria Khan has the easiest of catches to take and Ireland Women are now seven wickets down. Four wickets for Nashra Sandhu and her good run in the competition continues. Arlene Kelly walks out onto the field.
Commentary.Howout: c Javeria Khan b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: This is short as well and outside off. Leah Paul knocks this back past the bowler for a single.
Leah Paul strides out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nashra Sandhu has her third wicket and this should be the end of any hope for Ireland Women! Nashra Sandhu bowls this short and outside off.  Eimear Richardson goes well across the stumps and looks to paddle this towards fine leg. Not easy against a spinner as she has to generate all the power and ends up lobbing it up towards the short fine leg fielder. Sadia Iqbal takes another catch and Ireland Women lose their sixth wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Sadia Iqbal b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Another flighted delivery bowled outside off. Eimear Richardson looks to go leg side but ends up getting a leading edge over the bowler's head to the right.
Floats this one full and outside off. Eimear Richardson lobs this back down the pitch.
Nashra Sandhu bowls this full and into the stumps. Mary Waldron mistimes her shot into the leg side and sets off for a quick single. Some misunderstanding but the throw is wayward.
Slower back of a length delivery just outside off, Eimear Richardson punches it to covers.
Good length again angling into the middle and leg. Eimear Richardson swivels it away to the long leg region for a brace.
Good length delivery on off. Eimear Richardson picks it up and lofts it to the deep backward square leg region as the batters scamper for a couple.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries. Full and outside the leg. Eimear Richardson moves across and scoops it past the short fine-leg fielder for four.
FOUR MORE! SMOKED! Full and on the stumps. Eimear Richardson swats it to the deep mid-wicket fence for another boundary.
FOUR! CLUBBED! Full and on off. Eimear Richardson gets on one knee and lofts it over mid-on as the ball runs down to the long on region for a boundary.
Shortish on off. Mary Waldron taps it to the point fielder. A dot to end the over.
Flights this one full and outside off. Mary Waldron looks to play inside the line and gets beaten comprehensively.
Quicker on middle and leg, Mary Waldron looks to flick and gets hit high on the pad. No run.
Mary Waldron makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! Ireland Women looking to accelerate but it is not working here! Nashra Sandhu bowls a tossed-up delivery turned after pitching. Louise Little advances again for the heave but misses it completely as the ball gets past her and Muneeba Ali whips off the bails in a flash. Ireland Women lose another one as Louise Little departs for 3 and half their side is now back in the shed.
Commentary.Howout: st Muneeba Ali b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up again on the stumps. Louise Little uses her feet and lofts it to the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
Slower through the air on the stumps. Louise Little makes room and bunts it to covers.
FOUR MORE! Flatter and quicker on the stumps. Eimear Richardson pulls this one just wide of the short fine-leg fielder for back-to-back fours.
FOUR! Wrong'un outside off. Eimear Richardson shuffles across and paddles this over the fielder at short fine leg as the ball races to the rope for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off. Louise Little gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through covers for one.
Louise Little is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust as Tuba Hassan strikes! Overpitched outside off. Laura Delany uses her feet and hits it straight into the hands of Bismah Maroof at covers who takes a simple catch to dismiss the Irish skipper. Tuba Hassan is delighted as she gets her first one of the night and Ireland Women are four down now with another collapse on the cards.
Commentary.Howout: c Bismah Maroof b Tuba Hassan

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off. Laura Delany cuts it uppishly to deep point for a couple.
Full on the fifth stump, Laura Delany shuffles across to paddle sweep and misses off the pads.

Time for Drinks. Ireland Women are struggling at the halfway mark. They need another 108 off the last 10 overs at almost 11 runs to the over. Pakistan Women spinners have bowled brilliantly and made the run-scoring difficult for the Irish batters. Orla Prendergast departed after playing a handy cameo of 31 off 21. Ireland Women will now need their skipper Laura Delany to bat deep and make a match out of it.
Full and outside off. Laura Delany dabs this into the off side and takes off for a quick single.
continues to bowl short and outside off. Eimear Richardson gets this to cover-point for one.
Short and outside off. Eimear Richardson rocks back and punches this towards point.
Full and straight. Eimear Richardson does not connect her sweep well and it will be a dot.
Tosses this one full and wide outside off. Eimear Richardson strokes this towards wide long on for a couple of runs.
Nashra Sandhu floats this one full and outside off. Eimear Richardson dabs this back down the pitch.
Floated full and in line with the stumps. Laura Delany shimmies down and knocks this back to the bowler.
Continues to bowl short and outside off. Laura Delany misses once again as she is beaten by the extra bounce.
Short and outside off. Laura Delany looks to cut but misses.
Full and outside off. Eimear Richardson pushes this towards cover for one and gets off the mark.
Short onec again and into the stumps. Laura Delany clips thsi towards square leg for one.
Tuba Hassan gets some extra bounce. This is short and outside the off stump. Laura Delany dabs this towards point.

OUT! CAUGHT! Orla Prendergast's cameo comes to an end and Ireland Women are in all sorts of trouble! This is short as well and in line with the stumps. Orla Prendergast looks to pull this leg side but ends up top-edging it. The ball goes high towards backward square leg and Sadia Iqbal takes a easy catch. Eimear Richardson is the next batter making her way out to the center.
Commentary.Howout: c Sadia Iqbal b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Another short ball outside the off stump. Orla Prendergast hits this straight to cover point.
Continues to bowl short and outside off. Laura Delany cuts this to deep point for one.
Short and outside off. Orla Prendergast knock this down to long on for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Nashra Sandhu bowls this full and outside the off stump. Orla Prendergast hits this hard back down the ground towards long off for four runs.

FOUR! Nashra Sandhu is welcomed with a boundary! This is floated full and outside off. Orla Prendergast heaves this deep mid-wicket. The fielder comes off the ropes and the ball sails over her head for four runs.
Short and straying onto the pads. Orla Prendergast rocks back and clips this towards deep backward square leg for one.
Tosses this one full as well and into the stumps. Orla Prendergast looks to slog sweep and miscues her shot towards square leg.
Floats this into the stumps on a fuller length. Orla Prendergast clips this towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside the off stump. Laura Delany eases this down to long off for one.
Short and outside off. Orla Prendergast slaps this towards deep cover for one.
Nida Dar flights this full and outside off. Orla Prendergast hits this hard towards cover.
Full and just outside off. Laura Delany knocks this to the bowler's left. Ireland Women are 39 for the loss of two wickets after the Powerplay.
Floats this full and in line with the stumps. Laura Delany flicks this towards deep mid-wicket for two more runs.
Goes full and outside off. Orla Prendergast drives this to extra cover and gets one.
Full this time and outside off. Orla Prendergast strokes this towards deep cover for another brace.
Short and outside off. Orla Prendergast slaps this towards deep point for a couple of runs.
Aiman Anwer bowls this on a good length and outside off. Orla Prendergast knocks this towards cover.
A wicket maiden for Nida Dar to begin proceedings! This is short and outside off. Laura Delany knocks this towards cover.
Laura Delany is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Sharp catch behind the wicket and Nida Dar takes the big wicket of Gaby Lewis! The pressure was created the by the bowler as she keeps it really tight! This is on a fuller length and outside the off stump. Gaby Lewis looks to drive through the line but the ball spin in and takes an inside edge. Muneeba Ali makes no mistake behind the wicket and goes up in appeal! The umpire raises his finger and Ireland Women are two down now with their main batter making her way back to the shed.
Commentary.Howout: c Muneeba Ali b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted full and outside off. Gaby Lewis knocks this hard towards mid off. Make that four dot balls.
Third dot ball in a row. Gaby Lewis goes full once again and going down leg. Gaby Lewis gets her sweep to square leg once again.
Full and on the pads. Gaby Lewis sweeps this straight to the square leg fielder.
Nida Dar floats this one full and in line with the stumps. Gaby Lewis defends this back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Fatima Sana is timing the ball beautifully here! Another back-of-a-length delivery was served outside off. Orla Prendergast gets inside the line of the ball and pulls it towards deep square leg. The ball lands just in front of the rope for four runs.
Attempts a yorker but serves a low full toss outside off. Orla Prendergast knocks this straight to the fielder at cover-point.

SIX! That is some shot from Orla Prendergast! She is looking dangerous here! Fatima Sana bangs this in short and outside off. Orla Prendergast is down the wicket once again and pulls this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum!
Goes full once again and outside the off pole. Orla Prendergast looks to hit through the line but gets beaten.
FOUR! Controlled aggression from Orla Prendergast! This is full and outside the off stump. Orla Prendergast shuffles down the wicket and times this aerially towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Fatima Sana bowls this on a good length and angles this into the stumps. Orla Prendergast dabs this into the leg side.
Goes full once again and outside the off stump. Gaby Lewis is early into the shot as she pushes this towards point.
FOUR! Good shot from Gaby Lewis and she is vital for Ireland Women in this run chase! This is full and outside the off stump. Gaby Lewis lofts this towards long off for four runs.
Floats this one full and into the stumps. Orla Prendergast clips this into the leg side and takes one.
Play halted! Ayesha Naseem has pulled up her hamstring as she calls for some assistance from the physio near the boundary. She looks to be in some pain. The substitute will come in to replace her.
Flighted full and outside the off stump. Gaby Lewis strokes this towards deep cover-point into the gap and they take three runs.
Goes full once again and outside off. Gaby Lewis lofts this over mid on for a couple of runs.
Sadia Iqbal floats this full and outside the off stump. Gaby Lewis charges down and slices this towards point.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fatima Sana strikes the first one for Pakistan Women. Back of a length delivery outside off. Amy Hunter uses her feet and lofts it just around the mid-on region. She hits it from the toe end of her bat and miscues it to Nashra Sandhu who runs back from mid-on and takes it brilliantly over her head to dismiss Amy Hunter for 6. Pakistan Women pick up their first. Excellent effort in the field by Nashra Sandhu. Orla Prendergast walks in at number 3.
Commentary.Howout: c Nashra Sandhu b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length delivery angling in. Gaby Lewis whips it through mid-wicket for one.
Full-length on the stumps. Gaby Lewis defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Short of a length angling down the leg. Gaby Lewis pulls and misses.
Back of a length zips off the pitch. Gaby Lewis goes for the pull and wears it on her shoulder.
Good length delivery angling in. Amy Hunter prods forward and gets an inside edge to square leg for one.
Fatima Sana starts off with a fuller one outside off. Amy Hunter pushes it past the backward point for a couple.
Fatima Sana will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
Fuller on the stumps. Gaby Lewis uses her feet and bunts it to mid-on.
Full on off. Gaby Lewis prods forward and defends.
Full and on the stumps. Amy Hunter lofts it to mid-wicket for one.
Full and on the leg peg. Amy Hunter looks to work it on the onside. She gets a leading edge that goes on a bounce to Sadia Iqbal.
Flatter, and on off. Amy Hunter cuts it to a backward point.
Sadia Iqbal starts off with a tossed-up ball. Amy Hunter goes back and edges it past the short third fielder for a couple.
